title: write-order invariant is documented and tested end-to-end
description: The .msg-before-.env write ordering (lines 110-122 doc comment) is both documented with the exact crash scenario and tested by startup_scan_moves_orphan_msg_to_dead. This is genuinely correct and should be defended: a future contributor might think the order does not matter or suggest writing both in a single pass for efficiency. The comment explains exactly why the order is load-bearing and the test validates the recovery path.
